# eUttaranchal

> > Comprehensive travel and information portal for Uttarakhand, India, featuring pilgrimage tour packages, village directories, and tourism resources.

eUttaranchal serves as a complete guide to Uttarakhand state, offering Char Dham Yatra pilgrimage packages, travel booking services, and an extensive searchable database of over 15,000 villages across all districts. The platform combines tourism services with detailed demographic and geographic information about rural Uttarakhand.

## Key Topics

- Char Dham Yatra
- Uttarakhand Tourism
- Pilgrimage Packages
- Village Database
- Haridwar
- Dehradun
- Nainital
- Kedarnath
- Gangotri
- Yamunotri
- Rural Demographics
- District Directory
- Travel Booking
- Census Data
- Uttarakhand Villages

## Pilgrimage & Tour Packages

- [Char Dham Yatra Packages 2026](https://chardham.euttaranchal.com/): Complete Char Dham Yatra 2026 packages covering Yamunotri, Gangotri, Kedarnath, and Badrinath with luxury, budget, and deluxe tour options
- [Travel Quote Request](https://book.euttaranchal.com/): Request customized travel quotes for Uttarakhand tours, Char Dham Yatra packages, and personalized travel planning services

## Village & Geographic Information

- [Uttarakhand Village Search](https://www.villages.euttaranchal.com/): Searchable database of 15,000+ Uttarakhand villages with detailed demographics, census data, and information organized by villages, tehsils, and districts
- [Village Directory Index](https://www.villages.euttaranchal.com/index.php): Comprehensive village directory covering all Uttarakhand districts including Haridwar, Dehradun, Nainital, Almora, Chamoli, and others with census information

## Optional

- [Server Resources](https://rest.euttaranchal.com/): Server directory index for eUttaranchal platform resources
